detail.note: None when no two sets share a rule file; a pair that differs means the multi-set path perturbs a result

matched_rule_files_bitwise.note: two rule sets carrying the same rule file must give bitwise identical arms (DESIGN A8)

no_subject_dropped.note: a drop is a reported finding, not a failure of the job

fno_phase_present.note: no FNO timing file: the FNO phase did not run or failed
